result_text:
Contributor lists and the recent-contributors bar chart no longer cut off at `contributorsListLimit`. The reports module compiles and its one test class passes. I did not run a full landscape report against a large dataset, so the output is verified by reading the code, not by generating a report.

Changes, both in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`:

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` from the row stream in `saveContributorsTable`, along with the `limit` variable and the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. This covers `contributors.html`, `contributors-recent.html`, and `bots.html`, which all use this method.
- **`ContributorListsSection.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` in `getBarsHtml`, so the bar chart draws one bar per recently active contributor.

The `contributorsListLimit` setting stays in `LandscapeConfiguration` and is no longer read by these two places. Ordering is unchanged. Nothing is committed.
